meta.name: paper-search-usage
meta.description: This skill should be used when user asks to "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", "search PubMed", "find academic papers", "search IEEE", "search Scopus", or "look up scientific literature".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索并查找学术论文与科学文献
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速查找学术论文或科学文献
copy.tagline_en: Search and find academic papers and scientific literature
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly find academic papers or scientific literature

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的指令在多个学术平台搜索论文，并返回相关结果。
howto.when: 当你提到“搜索论文”、“查找学术文献”、“搜 arXiv”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下关于量子计算的 arXiv 论文。
say.note: Claude 会调用 arXiv 搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 在 PubMed 上找关于 CRISPR 的最新文章。
say.note: Claude 会调用 PubMed 搜索并返回结果。

say.text: 搜索 IEEE 上关于机器学习的论文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search academic papers across multiple platforms based on your instructions and return relevant results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "search for papers", "find research papers", "search arXiv", etc.

say_en.text: Search arXiv for papers on quantum computing.
say_en.note: Claude will call arXiv search and return results.

say_en.text: Find recent articles on CRISPR in PubMed.
say_en.note: Claude will call PubMed search and return results.

say_en.text: Search IEEE for papers on machine learning.
say_en.note: Claude will call IEEE Xplore search and return results.
